summary: Wired the revision chat button to the existing MD.api.revise(currentProjectId, message), then reused image filling, preview, version history and audit flows. User instructions and assistant status/error messages are rendered as plain text; controls are disabled without a project/deck or while busy, duplicate/blank submissions are ignored, and failed revisions retain the input for retry. Turnstile callbacks preserve the busy lock and project resume holds it through automatic revision. All six existing test entrypoints and six new DOM regression cases pass via npm run check in Git Bash, and README documents the browser interaction.
